item.title: Some oligarchs blocking entry of Starlink in India: Elon Musk
item.description: Elon Musk has claimed that certain oligarchs are obstructing Starlink's entry into the Indian market. Starlink has already established the necessary infrastructure and is prepared to launch its services. The company aims to provide affordable broadband connectivity to areas lacking internet access. Regulatory approvals are awaited before the commercial rollout can commence in India. Collaboration with local telecom operators has been a key element in Starlink's strategy for success.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH SINHA

item.title: IIT-B puts on hold 2026 rules on tough penalties for cheating
item.description: IIT-Bombay’s senate has halted new penalties for academic misconduct, reverting to the 2015 policy for upcoming examinations. This decision follows the recent death of a student suspected of cheating during an exam. An interim procedure allows faculty to document suspected dishonesty while encouraging student accounts on a separate form. Faculty members and students will present their cases before a disciplinary committee after the examination period.
item.dc:creator: HEMALI CHHAPIA

item.title: 'We'll do it': PM Modi gives slogan for 2047 goals
item.description: PM Narendra Modi delivered a speech highlighting his 25 years in government and the goal of developed India by 2047. He called upon citizens to commit to this ambitious target and emphasized the power of the people. Modi reiterated the importance of extraordinary goals, linking good governance to societal inclusion. He reflected on his journey from humble beginnings to leadership in the BJP.
item.dc:creator: KUMAR RAKESH

item.title: 'Fight goes on’: 87-yr-old woman dies after becoming symbol of Spain housing crisis
item.description: María del Carmen Abascal, known as Maricarmen, died in a hospital after being evicted from her home. Her eviction triggered nationwide protests highlighting the housing crisis afflicting Spain. Activists voiced anger over Maricarmen's death as a symbol of the struggle against rising rents and evictions. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez offered condolences, acknowledging the impact of her case on public sentiment.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Loans set to get dearer as RBI hikes repo rate after 44 months
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India has announced a 25 basis points increase in the repo rate to 5.5%. This decision reflects growing inflation pressures and stronger than anticipated economic growth. The rise in interest rates will lead to higher loan EMIs, impacting consumption during the festive season. Banks are expected to increase fixed deposit rates following this policy change.
item.dc:creator: MAYUR SHETTY

item.title: Google ordered to halt data center work in 'Texas of Europe; company admits ‘concerns’
item.description: Google has received an order to halt construction on its data center projects in Muhos and Kajaani. The Finnish Licensing and Supervision Agency has mandated that construction continues only after environmental impact assessments. Google acknowledged the concerns raised and stated that it would comply with the authority's guidance. The company has emphasized its commitment to biodiversity plans, including extensive tree planting.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Anti-CEC protests: Oppn, police face off again; Rahul says won’t stop till Gyanesh quits
item.description: Opposition members from the INDIA bloc attempted to stage a protest demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar. They were detained by Delhi Police less than a kilometer from their protest site at Jantar Mantar. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge organized the lunch gathering, where the protest plan was discussed. Difficulties in moving their buses led to further confrontations with police as they sought to demonstrate.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Texas court lets oil company cross 1,604-acre ranch to plug shut-in well
item.description: A Texas appeals court ruled that Allegiant Resources can access McFaddin Ranch to plug an inactive well. The dispute centers around the Remora Oil Unit No. 1 located near the San Antonio River. Virginia L. Dierlam, the ranch owner, previously secured a permanent injunction that limited access to the ranch. Allegiant argues that plugging the well is necessary to avoid environmental concerns, which the court acknowledged.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Living Planet Report: WWF finds 73% global wildlife decline; India shows recovery gains
item.description: A global decline of 73% in monitored wildlife populations occurred between 1970 and 2022. India has successfully improved populations of tigers, one-horned rhinos, and Ganga river dolphins. The report highlights threats like habitat loss, climate change, and pollution affecting wildlife. Despite the negative trends, about half of monitored populations are stable or increasing globally. Targeted conservation efforts in India demonstrate the potential for wildlife recovery and biodiversity preservation.
item.dc:creator: VISHWA MOHAN

item.title: Proselytising organisations can’t get FCRA registration: Madras HC
item.dc:creator: KAUSHIK KANNAN

item.title: Doctors, hospitals can't use AI to create testimonials: National Medical Commission
item.description: National Medical Commission has issued guidelines restricting the use of AI in medical advertising and patient testimonials. Registered medical practitioners and hospitals must not engage in creating synthetic content or manipulating search rankings. Claims of being the best or offering guaranteed results are also prohibited under these rules. Additionally, offering discounts or referrals that encourage unnecessary consultations is not allowed.
item.dc:creator: ANUJA JAISWAL

item.title: Sandra Bullock’s 91-acre California ranch with 1,200 avocado trees sells for $5.6m
item.description: In 2007, Sandra Bullock acquired a sprawling 91-acre ranch in Valley Center for $2.725 million. After transforming it with extensive renovations and establishing an organic avocado farm, she sold the property for $5.6 million in 2024. Encompassing a beautifully refurbished adobe house, a guest cottage, and facilities for agricultural operations, the ranch stands as a perfect blend of luxury and sustainability for its future owner.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Ricky Martin’s former Beverly Hills estate sells for $35m after major price cuts
item.description: A luxurious Beverly Hills mansion was recently sold for $35 million after being on the market for four months. Originally listed at $75 million, the price was reduced significantly due to lack of buyers despite its celebrity ownership history. The estate features a main residence, a guest house, and various recreational amenities including a tennis court and children's playground.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Priscilla Chan founded a school; 10 years later, Board votes to close it
item.description: Priscilla Chan's tuition-free private school in California has shut down after receiving over $125 million in funding. The school, which aimed to support low-income children and families, faced challenges leading to its closure. About 540 children were enrolled, and families expressed concern over the abrupt announcement of the closure. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative pledged $50 million to assist with transition services and education savings accounts.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Thrift shopper paid $1.50 for purse; Cartier piece later valued at $35,000
item.description: A thrift-store shopper who paid just $1.50 for a clutch in 2018 or 2019 discovered years later that it was a rare Cartier Art Deco piece. During a 2026 "Antiques Roadshow" appraisal, experts identified precious stones, platinum and the Cartier name inside, valuing the purse at about $35,000, with an insurance value above $100,000.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Make a good film, repay your debts: Supreme Court to Rajpal Yadav
item.description: Supreme Court has maintained the condition for Rajpal Yadav to deposit Rs 2 crore for his appeal. Yadav took a loan of Rs 5 crore in 2010 for a film that never completed, which has accrued interest. His counsel mentioned he secured Rs 1.15 crore and aims to sell property to cover remaining dues. The court suggested producing a successful film may help him repay the debts.
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: Assam CM Himanta Sarma says woman sent to Bangladesh safe, son counters CM
item.description: Mumtaz Begum, a woman expelled to Bangladesh, remains untraceable by her family despite official claims of her safety. Her son, Momruz Ali, is pleading for government assistance to locate her in either country. The Gauhati High Court directed authorities to find Mumtaz and provide interim compensation to her husband. Reports indicate that searches in Bangladesh yielded no results for her whereabouts so far.
item.dc:creator: ISMAT ARA

item.title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ $1.6m philanthropy: How are they helping 20,000 kids?
item.description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes have made children a major focus of their charitable work through the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation. Their efforts include a $1.625 million Boys & Girls Clubs commitment, a $1 million inclusive Kansas City playground, literacy programs reaching more than 20,000 students, community grants and food support for families facing hardship.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation: Why are Ed and Donna Kelce involved?
item.description: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation has not posted since January 2026. They continue their charitable work through Operation Breakthrough’s Ignition Lab. Donna Kelce met with Ignition Lab students during a Kansas City Chiefs game. Ed Kelce visited first graders at Operation Breakthrough. Travis Kelce’s foundation got its first post after January on Travis’ birthday.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Mamata Banerjee’s Delhi arrival fuels buzz over INDIA bloc meet with President
item.description: TMC chairperson Mamata Banerjee's arrival in Delhi has heightened anticipation for the requested meeting with President Droupadi Murmu. The opposition bloc is awaiting confirmation for a meeting date between October 7 and 9. The delegation has been limited to ten members as requested by the President's Secretariat. CPI(M)'s John Brittas has submitted a petition for constitutional intervention regarding the Election Commission.
item.dc:creator: AMBIKA PANDIT

item.title: With PM Modi set to visit Ottawa, India & Canada back CEPA
item.description: India and Canada are currently engaged in the fifth round of talks for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. Both countries aim to sign the CEPA during Prime Minister Modi's anticipated visit to Canada. The visit is tentatively scheduled for December 11-13, just before the G20 summit in Florida. Leaders from both nations envision boosting bilateral trade to CAD 70 billion by 2030.
item.dc:creator: SACHIN PARASHAR

item.title: Centre cites Supreme Court order, seeks to void Jharkhand DGP appointment
item.description: Supreme Court has agreed to hear the application from the Centre regarding Tadasha Mishra's appointment as Jharkhand DGP. The appointment has been challenged due to its conflict with procedures set in the SC's 2006 Prakash Singh judgement. Moreover, the Centre claimed that prior DGP appointments in Jharkhand were also illegal for similar reasons. Mishra's appointment occurred shortly before her retirement, which raised legal concerns.
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: Medical trips costliest in both rural & urban areas
item.description: Health and medical trips incurred the highest expenses in rural and urban areas during a one-year period. The average expenditure for these trips was notably higher in urban than rural areas. Pilgrimage travel accounted for the largest share of trips taken throughout the year. Accommodation and transport were significant expenditures for health and medical trips, underscoring their financial impact.
item.dc:creator: REMA NAGARAJAN

item.title: 'Cash-for transfers' WA chats part of CBI dossier on Mann OSD
item.description: A set of WhatsApp chats has emerged, alleging monetary transactions involving senior Punjab government officials and DSPs. CBI's dossier includes these chats as they prepare to interrogate CM Bhagwant Mann's OSD Rajbir Singh Ghuman. Allegations suggest that intermediaries received bribes for influencing transfers and policy formulations affecting IAS and IPS officers. Additionally, documents indicate potential irregularities in real estate projects and the Greater Mohali Area Development Authority.
item.dc:creator: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA AND VIBHOR MOHAN

item.title: Indian students' American dream hits a $70,000 toll
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: Oceans connect, not divide nations, PM Modi says, calls for secure maritime order
item.description: PM Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of maritime connectivity and proposed a ceasefire plan for the Black Sea. His vision promotes cooperation and mutual benefit among nations to ensure maritime security. Chief of Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan highlighted the interconnectedness of national security and economic security. He urged for collective action among regions to tackle maritime threats effectively.
item.dc:creator: DIPAK K DASH

item.title: 'One student, one day': CUET-UG 2027 may get shorter, simpler
item.description: CUET-UG 2027 may implement notable changes to streamline the examination experience for students. Candidates could see a reduction in the number of subjects from five to four over time. The proposed changes also include shortening the duration of individual papers to enhance efficiency. Subject grouping may allow related papers to be scheduled together for a single-day examination.
item.dc:creator: MANASH PRATIM GOHAIN

item.title: FBI foils alleged ISIS-linked attack plot at Mall of America by 18-year-old
item.description: Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud, an 18-year-old, was arrested for planning an attack on the Mall of America. He agreed to buy an AK-47 and ammunition from an undercover FBI agent posing as an ISIS member. Mohamud expressed intentions to kill non-Muslims during a scheduled Hmong arts celebration. US authorities stated that his radicalization was identified well before his plan could be executed.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: UK's oldest Indian restaurant owner accuses Crown Estate of not valuing curry traditions
item.description: Ranjit Mathrani, the owner of Veeraswamy, is taking legal action against the Crown Estate over lease refusal. He believes this reflects an undervaluation of Indian culinary traditions compared to European cuisine. The restaurant has a significant historical background with notable patrons, including Indian leaders. The Crown Estate maintains its decision is based on structural issues and not culinary bias.
item.dc:creator: NAOMI CANTON

item.title: ​IndiGo flight hit by lightning, damage found only after landing in Lucknow
item.description: An IndiGo flight experienced a lightning strike while approaching Lucknow, damaging its nose radome. The aircraft landed safely, with all 110 people onboard unharmed. The severity of the damage became clear only after the flight was parked. Authorities confirmed that the aircraft will undergo a comprehensive inspection and necessary repairs before service. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has been notified as per standard procedure.
item.dc:creator: ARVIND CHAUHAN

item.title: A lunch, then a march: How Rahul-led opposition once again kept police guessing
item.description: The episode was the latest example of a 'dhappa' style protest that Rahul Gandhi and the Congress have recently used. The latest episode began after Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge announced an INDIA bloc sit-in at Jantar Mantar following the lunch. "Today, we will hold a sit-in protest at Jantar Mantar. Until our demands are met, we will continue to stage such protests," Kharge announced.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: NIA court rejects bail plea of separatist Shabir Shah in 1996 funeral violence case
item.description: A Jammu NIA court rejected the bail application of Shabir Ahmad Shah, linked to a 30-year-old mob violence case. This case relates to violence during a terrorist's funeral procession in Srinagar, which Shah allegedly incited. The court expressed concern about potential threats to national security and the safety of protected witnesses. Shah argued that the investigation was reopened without justification and emphasized delays in legal actions.
item.dc:creator: NASEER GANAI

item.title: Grenade seizure case: Pakistan-based ultra declared ‘proclaimed offender’
item.description: A special NIA court in Jammu has declared Nazir Hussain a proclaimed offender regarding grenade seizures. Hussain, originally from Hari village, is believed to be hiding in Pakistan currently. The court noted that previous non-bailable arrest warrants could not be executed due to his absence from home. Additionally, multiple attempts to compel Hussain to surrender have been unsuccessful.
item.dc:creator: SANJAY KHAJURIA

item.title: ‘You are doing your job’: Detained Rahul Gandhi offers water to police - watch
item.dc:creator: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: India’s first high-altitude snow leopard safari flagged off in Ladakh
item.description: Ladakh has commenced India's first high-altitude wildlife safari that highlights snow leopard trails and community involvement. Vinai Kumar Saxena, the lieutenant governor, emphasized the importance of coexisting wildlife and development. The Snow Leopard and High-Altitude Nature Conservation Society is coordinating this project with local forest departments. The mapped safari routes traverse significant wildlife areas, including Hemis National Park and Changthang.
item.dc:creator: SANJAY KHAJURIA

item.title: ‘Nobody can stop Bumrah & Bhuvi’: Ashwin’s bold prediction as pacer makes India return
item.description: Ravichandran Ashwin asserts that Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s display in New Zealand might have a significant impact on his chances for World Cup selection. Having last participated in an ODI in 2022, Bhuvneshwar is set to make his return to international cricket. His capacity to swing the ball could enhance India's bowling lineup for next year’s championship.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Delhi building collapse: Pregnant woman, child among 3 killed in Seemapuri; 8 injured
item.description: In Seemapuri, Delhi, a tragic building collapse resulted in the loss of three lives, including a child, with eight others injured. The incident, which occurred around 3.15 PM, activated swift rescue operations by both locals and authorities. Concerns about the building’s structural stability arose following recent earthquakes in Uttarakhand. Investigations into the cause of the collapse are ongoing, with local traffic also disrupted due to the incident.
item.dc:creator: PRACHI KUMAWAT

item.title: Zohran Mamdani faces backlash for calling Israel’s Gaza war ‘ongoing genocide’ on Oct 7 anniversary
item.dc:creator: AASHISH VASHISTHA

item.title: From 'vote chori' to 'chita andolan': Street protests return with a new playbook
item.description: From 'vote chori' protests and women’s safety marches to 'Chita Andolan', the streets are getting politically crowded again. But the old politics of protest now comes with a new playbook. Younger voices, looser networks, social media, viral slogans and issue-based mobilisation are changing how protests begin, spread and draw attention.
item.dc:creator: PRIYANKA MUKHERJEE

item.title: Out on bail after rape allegation, Porel named in Bengal squad for Ranji opener
item.description: Wicketkeeper-batter Abhishek Porel has been included in Bengal's squad for their upcoming Ranji Trophy match. He was previously arrested on allegations of rape but has since been granted bail. The team has named a strong squad with senior pacers Mohammed Shami and Akash Deep included. Bengal's match against Delhi is set to take place in Kalyani to mark the season opener.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Akhilesh not invited to INDIA bloc lunch? SP chief's 'samosa' response
item.dc:creator: VIVEK DUBEY

item.title: A musician collected 51 rare guitars worth $1.4m, then donated them to students
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: ‘Changed Shreyas’ grip & backlift’: How Nayar helped India T20I captain bounce back
item.description: Facing a troubling drop in performance, with no scores exceeding 30 in his last ten T20I outings, Shreyas Iyer turned to Abhishek Nayar for help. Their two-hour conversation revolved around critical adjustments to Iyer's batting style. The results were evident as Iyer responded with a stellar 102 not out in the first T20I against West Indies, underscoring his tenacity and capacity to rebound from tough situations.
item.dc:creator: GAURAV GUPTA
